label: coach_gym_mushi_first_00
text: My name is Katy, and I am the owner of\nPatisserie Soapberry in the Paldea region![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_first_01
text: Oh? That’s right, I was called here as a Gym\nLeader, not a patissier![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_01
text: I didn’t think I’d run into you in a faraway place\nlike this![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_select_01
text: I’m the one that called you

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_select_02
text: Small world, huh?

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_02
text: Oh, you’re the one who called me here? I’m\nflattered![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_02b
text:
Hmm, but you don’t seem very surprised to
see me here...\c
Oh, wait, don’t tell me—you’re the one who
called me here, aren’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_03
text: Hehehe, now our chance encounter suddenly\nseems to make sense![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_04
text: Well then, I ought to slip into coach mode if I\nwas called here as such![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_05
text: I think it’s high time we taught this academy how\nlovely Bug-type Pokémon are![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_01
text: Not too long ago, I was taking a nice stroll\nthrough this school’s wonderful Terarium...[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_02
text: and I just so happened to run into an adorable\nlittle Bug-type Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_03
text:
It was a small thing—and so cute! Not only was it
a Bug type, but it was an Electric type, too!\c
You wouldn’t happen to know its name, would
you?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_select_01
text: Elekid

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_select_02
text: Chinchou

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_select_03
text: Joltik

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_04
text:
Hmm, no, I don’t think that’s it. That’s not even a
bug Pokémon, is it?\c
It was letting out a little cry, like so: “Jol! Jol!”
Oh, could it have been a Joltik?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_04b
text: Yes, I think you’re right! Its cry sounded like\n“Jol! Jol!” too![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_05
text: And it seems like this is a bug Pokémon that can’t\nbe found in Paldea! How interesting![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_06
text: Maybe I’ll use that cute little Joltik as inspiration\nfor some new sweets![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! I’ve got a little
pop
quiz
for
you![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_01
text: Do you think you can guess which Pokémon from\nthe Terarium newly joined my team?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_02
text: [EMPTY 63]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_select_01
text: Galvantula

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_select_02
text: Araquanid

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_select_03
text: Ariados

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_select_04
text: [EMPTY 63]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_03
text: Oh no, that’s not quite right! Go on, think a little\nharder![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_03b
text: Ding ding ding! You are correct, correct, correct!\nMy, you must’ve been keeping a close eye on me![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_04
text: Araquanid is a Water type, you know! And it\nlives near bodies of water![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_05
text: Why don’t you try to find it next time you’re\ntaking a stroll through the Terarium?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_01_00
text: Thanks to you calling me here, I was able to\nmeet new bug Pokémon! I’m so happy![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_01_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Do you fancy becoming a bug Pokémon\nenthusiast yourself, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_01_02
text: Come on, let’s trade and get you a whooole\nbunch of bug Pokémon to train up![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_01_03
text: Wonderful! I have a Combee to trade—what\nabout you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_01_04
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x1303(0001,0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)]! How adorable, thank you!
I’ll
see
that
it
undergoes a lovely metamorphosis![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_02_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You’re sure you want to trade your
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]
for
my
Combee?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_02_01
text: You can’t trade Katy a Pokémon if you aren’t its\noriginal Trainer!

label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_02_02
text: You can’t trade Katy such a rare Pokémon!

label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_02_03
text: You can’t trade Katy a Shiny Pokémon!

label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_03_00
text:
Oh? You can’t trade a Pokémon if it’s the only
one in your party!\c
Make sure you have at least two and come see
me again![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_03_01
text: Come see me again if you want to make a new\nbug Pokémon friend![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_04_00
text: Oh? Do you want to trade for a bug Pokémon\nafter all?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_talkto_00
text: Oh, my! Could this be an invitation to battle?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_cancel_00
text: Oh no, I suppose I was mistaken! Looks like I got\nahead of myself...[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_battlestart_00
text: I can’t wait to get a taste of your tactics! I bet\nyou’ve really emerged from your cocoon since\r\nlast time![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01
text: [EMPTY 63]

label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_00_00
text: I suppose I should expect no less from a Trainer\nsuch as you! You made quick work of my team![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_00_01
text: You really have grown into such a beautiful\nyoung Trainer![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_00_02
text: Could I interest you in a little dessert after your\nvictory?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_00_03
text: I hope the road ahead of you continues to be\nsweet and gentle![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_paldea_rival_reward_00
text: [EMPTY 63]

label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_01_00
text: You’ve won against my lovely Bug-type Pokémon!\nWell done, sweetie![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_01_01
text: Hehe, I look forward to our next battle![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_lose_00_00
text: Hehe, I managed to net a win against you! What\na wonderful feeling! Thanks for the battle![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_00
text:
I just love taking walks in the Terarium!\c
There are oodles of Pokémon I’ve never seen
before! They’ve given me so many ideas for
new sweets![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_01
text:
It’s thanks to the hard work of my staff at
Patisserie Soapberry that I’m able to go on
excursions like this!\c
Don’t forget to cherish all the people who
support you![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_02
text:
You know those antennae Pokémon get when
they Terastallize to the Bug type?\c
Oh, they’re so cute! I wish all Pokémon had the
Bug Tera Type![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Your little [VAR 0x0101(0001)] has quite the
appetite!\c
It’s happily gobbling up all the sweets I’ve been
making for it![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_04
text: The Combee I traded you is a female, so you\ncan expect her to evolve into a Vespiquen![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_sp
text:
Oh, I just remembered something La Primera
told me!\c
It seems that you picked me as your favorite
Gym Leader?\c
Aren’t you just the sweetest! Thank you so much!
I’ll make some cupcakes just for you sometime![VAR 0x0114(0016)]
